name: Fire in Operating Room
summary:
Fire in Operating Room is an immersive VR training simulation designed to prepare healthcare professionals and students for one of the most critical emergencies in a surgical setting. Step into a realistic operating room where a fire incident unfolds, requiring immediate action, clear thinking, and coordinated teamwork.
